reigns.note: Telamonian archer — not Scamander's Teucer of the Troad (teucer-troas) — expelled from Attic Salamis after Troy; he founded Cypriot Salamis and wed the daughter of Cinyras. Pausanias makes that marriage the stem of the island's Teucrid royal house. Cinyras himself founded and reigned at Paphos (Apollod. Bibliotheca 3.14.3), not on this throne. See nested episode teucer-to-cyprus.

King of Cyprus whom Pausanias sets as the last named heir of Teucer's royal house — he traced his pedigree to Teucer and the daughter of Cinyras and caused Artaxerxes to give Conon the Phoenician fleet. Intermediate Teucrid kings are unnamed in the seven lenses. Plain attested name (≠ Neleus' son Evagoras, ≠ Priam's son Evagoras).
